config.name: distributeImage
config.description: whether to destribute images to primary storage cache after they are added

config.name: distributeImage.concurrency
config.description: the number of images that can be distrubuted in parallel

config.name: vm.consoleMode
config.description: console mode for VM transport protocol. When set to spice, enable the spice protocol connection for VM. Options:[vnc, spice]

config.name: apiRetry.vm
config.description: the retry times when a VM related API fails

config.name: apiRetry.interval.vm
config.description: the sleep time before retrying a failed VM related API, in second

config.name: aio.native
config.description: enable qemu native aio, it can set only if cache is none

config.name: qcow2.cluster.size
config.description: qcow2 cluster size, must be power of 2 and between 512 to 2097152, units in bytes

config.name: deleteTempImages
config.description: delete temp images after VMs are cloned, created from volume or recovered from backup.

config.name: xfsFragScrape.interval
config.description: the interval to scrap xfs fragmentation, in hours

config.name: xfsVolumeDetect.size
config.description: the threshold size to scrape volume xfs fragmentation, in GiB

config.name: license.scrape.interval
config.description: the interval to scrap license info, in second

config.name: enableSpiceChannelSupportTLS
config.description: spice channel supports TLS encrypted transmission data. Options:[main, display, inputs, cursor, playback, record, smartcard, usbredir]

config.name: enableCgroupDeviceAcl
config.description: enable cgroup device acl in qemu configuration

config.name: pause.world
config.description: reject all scheduler job, ha and api which is not read only

config.name: vm.windows.auto.attach.virtio.driver.format
config.description: the format of the virtio dirver installer is attached to a new created windows virtio vm
